title: checklist: platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal acceptance[0] and [3] still drive connector as the one-holder-per-deployment type, but #33431 narrowed connector per namespace and no covered type is left
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Kind: stale spec → re-point card (checklist item revision; the product is right)

## What the run saw (objectstack main a557fa386bc3)

`platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal` rev 5 drives the connector `qa_conn` as "the one covered type `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` does not list at this revision", and asks the runner to re-read that complement before the run. At a557fa38 the list ends with `'connector'` under `// #31699 PR 3 (the narrowing PR)` (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, lines 160-178), landed by #33431 (322ded7da, 2026-11-14, after the 18.4.0 tag 181ad7d4). Every member of `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` (lines 103-122) is now in the namespace list, so the complement is empty.

Live, on a showcase scratch copy with its own OS_HOME:

1. `os package install` com.qa.addr-a (ns qa_a) then com.qa.addr-b (ns qa_b), each declaring `connectors: [{ name: 'qa_conn', type: 'api', enabled: false }]`: both install. `GET /api/v1/meta/connector` lists `qa_conn` under each package; bare `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_conn` answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. acceptance[0] expects 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` for the second.
2. A cold boot of one `composeStacks([d, c], { manifest: 'preserve' })` artifact whose two namespaced packages both declare connector `qa_conn` boots and logs no "Bare-name conflict at boot" warning. acceptance[3] expects one.

acceptance[1], [2] and every negative passed. The item's own text foresaw this ("a type the list has gained is now acceptance[1]'s"), but with nothing left outside the list, acceptance[0] and [3] have no type to drive.

## Re-point proposal

- acceptance[1]: add connector to the per-namespace set (connector #33431) and drop "connector alone at this revision".
- acceptance[0]: the 422 still occurs when the second holder has no namespace. In this run's probe, a namespace-less package com.qa.addr-e declaring connector `qa_conn` after qa_a got 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`, "Bare-name conflict: package \"com.qa.addr-e\" cannot register a name another holder already holds — … connector \"qa_conn\", already held by package \"com.qa.addr-a\" …". Re-point the clause to that co-owner (namespace-less, or same-namespace) shape, or retire it. Its message carries the stale reason sentence tracked in #33507.
- acceptance[3]: decide whether a cold-boot warning still exists for any pair, for example two namespace-less code packages. If one does, re-point the fixture to it. If not, retire the clause and keep negative[1] (the boot is not refused).
- fixtures.requires[1]: keep the composeStacks preserve fixture, which builds and boots as written.

## Duplicates searched

- `gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open "platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal"'` returned 1: #33353 (next-sweep hand-overs, row 114, about acceptance[2]'s email-service resolution, not this).
- `… is:open bare-name connector narrowed checklist` returned 6, none about this item.
- `… is:open checklist connector namespace 33431` returned 1, a PM seat card.
- `… is:open bareNameReason one name per deployment` returned #33507 (the refusal's reason sentence). That card is related but covers product copy, not the checklist clause.

Severity guess: p2 (checklist accuracy; two clauses cannot be scored).
